name: 2D Gaussian Projection and Basis Calculation
aliases: 2D Gaussian Splatting Projection and Basis Calculation
definition: Computes the 2D screen-space basis vectors and eigenvalues for a 3D Gaussian splat by projecting its 3D covariance matrix through the view and projection matrices, then extracting the eigenvectors and eigenvalues of the resulting 2D covariance matrix.
summary: 2D Gaussian Projection and Basis Calculation transforms 3D Gaussian splats into screen-space ellipses by projecting their covariance matrices to compute orthogonal basis vectors and scales for rasterization.
